title: A new order makes no sound, notification or badge anywhere, and the kitchen screen never shows it until someone confirms it on the Orders page
steps: Log in as admin-user; open /dashboard/kitchen (Brixton Village Grill) on a tablet and tap the page once (audio gesture); open /dashboard/orders on a phone
Place a cash order at /shop/brixton-village-grill as a guest
Watch both screens for 40 s without reloading; instrument AudioContext/Oscillator, Notification, navigator.vibrate and document.title
expected: A new order announces itself loudly (repeating until acknowledged) on the kitchen screen and the counter phone, and appears on the kitchen board as NEW
actual: 7/7 orders: phone list showed the row in 1.1-5.1 s but with 0 beeps/notifications/vibrations and no title change; the kitchen board never showed any of them (it lists only CONFIRMED/PREPARING/READY). The only kitchen beep fires when an order is CONFIRMED (kitchen/page.tsx:496-499), i.e. in reaction to the vendor's own tap - 9 beeps during the test were other users' confirmations
realWorldImpact: On a busy night an order nobody happens to see sits in Pending indefinitely; the customer was told 'the shop will confirm it shortly' and waits, then phones or goes to Just Eat. Worse than the WhatsApp buzz it replaces

title: The kitchen ticket hides the customer's note ('nut allergy!', 'no pepper') and does not say collection or delivery
steps: Place a delivery order with Order notes 'nut allergy! please be careful'
Confirm it on /dashboard/orders
Read the ticket on /dashboard/kitchen
expected: The ticket the cook reads shows the customer's note prominently, and COLLECTION/DELIVERY
actual: Ticket text: 'ORD... Confirmed ALLERGENS Gluten, Eggs, Mustard Tolu Funmi-Cust 2 items 2x Lamb Kebab 1x Coleslaw 16m ago Start Preparing' - no note, no fulfilment type. The note is visible only on /dashboard/orders/{id}. (The print ticket component kitchen-ticket.tsx does render notes and fulfilment - code-read, not printed)
realWorldImpact: The cook never sees a free-text allergy warning; a nut-allergic customer can be served cross-contaminated food. Licence/reputation and safety risk

title: If the vendor changes a price while a customer is on checkout, the customer is charged the new price without being told
steps: Customer: add Peri Peri Chicken (£9.00) + Coleslaw, open checkout, choose Collection - Total £11.50
Vendor: Products > Edit Peri Peri Chicken > price 9.50 > Update
Customer (no reload): fill details, tap Place order
expected: Checkout either refreshes the total or refuses with 'prices changed, please review' before placing
actual: Screen showed 'Total £11.50' at the tap; POST returned 201 with totalAmountPennies 1200; confirmation reads 'Total £12.00' with no notice of a change
realWorldImpact: Customer pays more than the price displayed at commitment - a pricing complaint (CPUTR misleading price) and a row at the till over cash

title: A delivery customer's tracking page says 'Ready for collection'
steps: Place a DELIVERY order
Confirm, Start Preparing, Mark Ready on the vendor side
Open the customer's tracking page
expected: Ready step says 'Out for delivery' / 'On its way' for delivery orders (as the email does)
actual: Ready step reads 'Ready for collection · 23:34' for delivery order ORD-...-8EAF908A, while the Ready email says 'There's no need to come to the shop'
realWorldImpact: Delivery customers walk to the shop or phone to ask; the two channels contradict each other

title: Cancelling an order is one unconfirmed tap with no reason, and the customer is told nothing useful
steps: On the phone Orders list tap Cancel on a Pending row
Observe: no confirmation dialog, no reason field
Open the customer's tracking page and Mailhog
expected: Confirm step (Cancel sits next to Confirm), a reason (customer asked / out of stock / closing), and the reason relayed to the customer with the shop's phone
actual: 3/3 cancels: immediate, no dialog, no reason. Customer sees 'This order was cancelled. If this was unexpected, please contact the shop.' Email: 'has been cancelled. Previous status: PENDING'. Shop has no phone on the storefront. Refusal and customer-requested cancel are indistinguishable
realWorldImpact: A greasy thumb cancels a paying order irreversibly; a refused customer doesn't know why and can't reach the shop

title: There is no way to pause or stop taking orders when the kitchen is overwhelmed; the only lever (opening hours) changes the shop's public link
steps: Open /dashboard/shops; look for pause/busy/accepting-orders control
Open Edit Shop for Brixton Village Grill
Read ShopService.updateShop slug handling
expected: A one-tap 'Pause new orders for 20/40 min' that the storefront and checkout respect, with a customer-facing message
actual: No switch anywhere; Edit Shop has only free-text opening hours per day. Saving Edit Shop regenerates the slug (ShopService.java:269 generateSlug when request slug blank; the form never sends slug). Not saved on the shared shop to protect other testers
realWorldImpact: Funmi cannot stop the flood without breaking every shared link/QR code; she will ignore orders instead, which is worse for customers

title: Cannot find an order by customer name - no search on Orders or Customers, and the phone table is clipped
steps: Customer at the counter: 'I ordered, name is Bisi'
On the phone open /dashboard/orders - look for search
Open /dashboard/customers - look for search
expected: A search box (name / last 4 of order number / phone) at the top of Orders
actual: 0 search inputs on either page; only a status filter and 20-row pages. In the All shops view a 13-minute-old order was already off page 1 (126 orders, 7 pages). At 393 px the 30-char order number wraps to 4 lines and the status/action columns are cut off the right edge
realWorldImpact: Queue at the counter grows while she scrolls; wrong order handed over

title: End of night: no takings for today, and cash orders count as revenue while still marked Unpaid
steps: Complete several cash orders
Open /dashboard/finance on the phone
Open a completed order's detail
expected: Today's takings (cash vs card), a date picker, and a way to mark cash received so the till reconciles
actual: Finance shows only all-time Revenue £384.98 / 23 transactions, no date input, no cash/card split; completed cash order detail shows 'PAYMENT STATUS NONE / METHOD Unpaid'
realWorldImpact: Cannot reconcile the till or spot a missing £20; back to a paper notebook

title: When an item is 86'd mid-basket, checkout shows a bare error with no way to fix the basket, and the basket still sells it
steps: Customer has Sweet Potato Fries in basket on checkout
Vendor unticks Available on Sweet Potato Fries
Customer taps Place order; then opens basket
expected: Checkout flags the item as sold out with a one-tap remove; basket marks it unavailable
actual: Server correctly returns 400 'Product is not available: Sweet Potato Fries'; page shows that text only; checkout did not update live; basket page lists Fries at £4.00 as normal while the menu no longer shows it
realWorldImpact: Customer must guess how to recover; some abandon

title: Nobody knows when an order is due - no promise time on tickets or for customers
steps: Confirm an order
Read the ticket and the customer's tracking page
expected: Ticket shows due time / order of cooking; customer sees an estimated ready time
actual: Ticket shows only '20m ago' counted from placement (not confirmation); tracking and emails give no time
realWorldImpact: Kitchen cooks in the wrong order; customers turn up too early and crowd the counter

title: 86ing an item or changing a price takes four taps and about 30 seconds in a long form
steps: Products > Edit (32x32 icon) > scroll to 16x16 'Available' checkbox > Update Product
expected: One-tap sold-out toggle on the product row
actual: 4 taps, ~30 s per change on a throttled phone (s4.log save timings); no quick toggle
realWorldImpact: Items stay on sale after they run out during the rush

title: Order action buttons on the phone are small and Cancel sits right next to Confirm
steps: Measure row buttons on a 393 px phone
expected: >=44 px tall targets, destructive action separated
actual: Confirm 97x32, Cancel 87x32, Start Prep 112x32, Mark Ready 120x32, Complete 108x32
realWorldImpact: Mis-taps with greasy fingers - including irreversible cancels (see P2-FUN-05)

title: On a landscape tablet the kitchen board wastes most of the screen and truncates the order number
steps: Open /dashboard/kitchen at 1024x768
expected: Full-screen ticket rail; order number (or short code) readable
actual: Navy sidebar takes ~25% width; title + All-shops banner take ~40% height; each ticket ~22% width; number shown as 'ORD...'
realWorldImpact: Fewer tickets visible; can't match a ticket to a shouted order number

title: Unanswered orders stay Pending forever and the customer is never told
steps: Open /dashboard/orders
expected: Pending orders time out (auto-reject with a message) after N minutes
actual: Orders from 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-13 still 'Pending' with Confirm buttons
realWorldImpact: Combined with P2-FUN-01, customers wait indefinitely for food that is never made

title: Status emails say nothing useful: no items, no shop address/phone, and 'Previous status: PENDING' jargon
steps: Move an order through all states; read Mailhog
expected: Emails list items, total, shop address/phone and the reason for a cancellation
actual: Each email is 2-3 generic lines plus a tracking link
realWorldImpact: Customers phone the shop to ask

title: Place order button shows a card icon on a cash-only order
steps: Open checkout for a cash-only shop
expected: Cash icon / 'Place order - pay cash'
actual: Card icon on 'Place order · £13.00'
realWorldImpact: Small doubt that a card will be charged

title: Positive: the phone Orders list updates live - new orders appeared in 1-5 seconds without refreshing
steps: Keep /dashboard/orders open; place orders
expected: Live list
actual: 7/7 rows appeared in 1.1-5.1 s
realWorldImpact: Keep this

title: Positive: bumping tickets on the kitchen screen is fast and big-buttoned, and every step reaches the customer
steps: Confirm then Start Preparing / Mark Ready / Complete on the tablet
expected: Quick bump with customer updates
actual: Ticket arrives 2.8-4.4 s after confirm; 44 px buttons answer in ~0.4 s; completed tickets leave; tracking updates within the 15 s poll and an email is in Mailhog within ~3 s; per-line allergen badges
realWorldImpact: Keep this

title: Positive: an order containing a sold-out item is refused by the server
steps: 86 an item while it is in a basket; place the order
expected: No order for food the kitchen can't make
actual: 400 'Product is not available'
realWorldImpact: Keep this (fix the recovery UX, P2-FUN-09)

title: Positive: a kitchen tablet left open for 38 minutes stays live and still receives and bumps new tickets
steps: Fresh vendor login on a 1024x768 tablet, open the KDS for Brixton Village Grill, leave untouched 38 min
Place a guest order and confirm it from a separate phone login
Bump it Start Preparing / Mark Ready / Complete on the tablet
expected: KDS keeps its session and feed through a whole service
actual: Live pill refreshed every 2 min with 0 auth errors; order ORD-00000000-20261004-D6431308 appeared 3.0 s after confirm with a beep; all three bumps returned 200
realWorldImpact: Keep this - the screen on the pass can be left alone all evening
